_comment: Prefer: `deckhand hooks install cursor` (writes an absolute path so Cursor.app can find deckhand without PATH). Manual install: merge into ~/.cursor/hooks.json. Each command reads Cursor's stdin JSON and POSTs a normalized payload via `deckhand hooks ingest cursor`. On `stop`, Deckhand maps the session to awaiting_input (Cursor has no explicit waiting-for-user event). Replace DECKHAND_BIN with the absolute path from `which deckhand`.

stop._comment: stop → awaiting_input so focus_next_pending / Agent Status can surface this session.
stop.command: DECKHAND_BIN hooks ingest cursor --event stop --status awaiting_input
